verses.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਦਰਸ ਧਿਆਨ ਗਿਆਨ ਅੰਜਮ ਕੈ ਮਿਤ੍ਰ ਸਤ੍ਰਤਾ ਨਿਵਾਰੀ ਪੂਰਨ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: satigur dharas dhiaan giaan a(n)jam kai mitr satrataa nivaaree pooran braham hai ||

en.bdb: By concentrating mind on the vision and by toiling on Naam Simran with rapt attention, one destroys all enmity and friendship and experiences presence of One Lord God.

verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਉਪਦੇਸ ਪਰਵੇਸ ਆਦਿ ਕਉ ਆਦੇਸ ਉਸਤਤਿ ਨਿੰਦਾ ਮੇਟਿ ਗੰਮਿਤਾ ਅਗਮ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: gur upadhes paraves aadh kau aadhes usatat ni(n)dhaa meT ga(n)mitaa agam hai ||

en.bdb: By imbibing the words of the Guru in one's heart and by the counsel of the True Guru can one indulge in His praise humbly. All desires of praise and slander are destroyed and one reaches the inaccessible Lord.

verses.gurmukhi: ਚਰਨ ਸਰਨਿ ਗਹੇ ਧਾਵਤ ਬਰਜਿ ਰਾਖੇ ਆਸਾ ਮਨਸਾ ਥਕਤ ਸਫਲ ਜਨਮ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: charan saran gahe dhaavat baraj raakhe aasaa manasaa thakat safal janam hai ||

en.bdb: By taking the refuge of a True Guru, a mind chasing vices and other evil pleasures come to rest. All desires and expectations end. Thus a human birth becomes a success.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸਾਧ ਸੰਗਿ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਨੇਮ ਜੀਵਨ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਗਤਿ ਕਾਮ ਨਿਹਕਾਮ ਨਿਹਕਰਮ ਕਰਮ ਹੈ ॥੮੨॥
verses.translit_en: saadh sa(n)g prem nem jeevan mukat gat kaam nihakaam nihakaram karam hai ||82||

en.bdb: Through joining the congregation of the Guru (Sadh Sangat), one reaches the state of emancipation while alive (Jeevan Mukt). One feels unaffected by worldly desires and instead focusses on Simran and Seva without desire for any reward. (82)
